data.title: Israel-bound plane diverted after co-pilot stabs captain
data.description: JERUSALEM - The co-pilot of a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv tried to crash the plane after stabbing the pilot, but passengers ​then held him ⁠down while other pilots landed the plane safely in Saudi Arabia, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Wednesday.

data.title: China opens ‘military support centre’ in Laos
data.description: ⁠China has opened ​a new military support and training centre in ​Laos, the Ministry ‌of National Defence said in Beijing as it announced a rare overseas expansion.

data.title: Northern Ireland police probe blockade of divisive parade
data.description: PORTADOWN, Northern Ireland - The police chief of Northern Ireland said Wednesday a criminal probe was under way into protests blocking a pro-British Protestant parade through a mainly Catholic area, as the standoff dragged into a fourth day despite ongoing talks.

data.title: Israel-bound plane diverted after cockpit stabbing
data.description: JERUSALEM - The co-pilot ‌of a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv is believed to have stabbed the captain in a possible attempted “terror attack” on Wednesday, forcing the plane to divert to Saudi Arabia where it landed safely, three Israeli officials said.

data.title: British PM reopens debate on rejoining EU
data.description: LONDON - Andy Burnham put the idea of Britain rejoining the EU on the table on Wednesday, breaking a taboo for a British prime minister and reopening the divisive Brexit debate.

data.title: Russia targets Kyiv power supply as winter approaches
data.description: KYIV - Russia hit Ukrainian energy infrastructure in a wave of deadly drone and missile strikes on Wednesday, prompting an urgent call for civil contingencies as freezing winter approaches.

data.title: ‘Do something,’ begs Iranian woman facing death sentence
data.description: An Iranian woman sentenced to death over protests in Iran earlier this year has begged the international community to save her life and others facing the death penalty, according to an audio message from prison shared by rights groups on Wednesday.

data.title: Israel-bound plane rerouted after cockpit fight
data.description: TABUK, Saudi Arabia - Two pilots were wounded after they reportedly fought on board the plane they were flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv, and which was forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday.

data.title: Swedish truth commission on Sami people seeks redress
data.description: STOCKHOLM - A Swedish truth commission on Wednesday urged the state to apologise for injustices committed against its indigenous Sami people, including assimilation programmes, and provide compensation and redress.

data.title: Turkey freezes ex-minister's assets as fund crisis grows
data.description: ISTANBUL — Turkish prosecutors have moved to freeze the assets of a top governing party official and former minister who resigned at the weekend over allegations she profited from an investment fund crisis.

data.title: What we know about the North Korean POW dispute
data.description: SEOUL — The transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war (POWs) from Ukraine to South Korea has sparked a rare public diplomatic row between Seoul and Kyiv.

data.title: Melting ice ‘transforming’ polar ocean habitats
data.description: PARIS - Climate change is increasingly reshaping the polar oceans, with Arctic waters warming rapidly, sea ice shrinking and wildlife losing habitat at both ends of the planet, a report said on Wednesday.

data.title: Whisky, big-screen TV seized from Indonesian prison ‘villas’
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesian authorities raided a prison outside Jakarta on Wednesday where inmates have allegedly been paying to live in luxury, emptying several “villas” of furniture, bottles of alcohol and at least one big-screen TV.

data.title: Lost shark becomes viral star in South Korea
data.description: SEOUL - A wayward shark has become an unlikely celebrity in South Korea, drawing massive crowds, earning plaudits from the local mayor and even moving the stock market.

data.title: India's fat dog vote goes viral
data.description: NEW DELHI - India's capital has gone to the dogs, as voters choose which of the city's chubbiest canines deserves to be crowned its fattest.

data.title: North Korean leader 'extremely obese': Seoul spy agency
data.description: SEOUL - North Korean leader Kim Jong Un is understood to be "extremely obese", Seoul's spy agency said Wednesday, citing its latest assessment of the reclusive leader's health.

data.title: Malaysia's ex-PM Mahathir in hospital for observation
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Malaysia's 101-year-old former prime minister Mahathir Mohamad has been hospitalised for observation, his aide told AFP Wednesday, a day after the death of his wife of seven decades.

data.title: Radio waves coming from an alien planet may be a cosmic first
data.description: NEW YORK — Radio waves streaming from an alien planet may offer a new tool in the hunt for life elsewhere in the universe.

data.title: Thieves swipe drugs under nose of Fiji police, swap with flour
data.description: SYDNEY — Detectives were sifting leads Wednesday after a massive drug heist in Fiji, searching for dozens of cocaine parcels swiped from an evidence vault and replaced with baking flour.

data.title: North Korea denies South's claim it was apparently behind DMZ mine blasts
data.description: SEOUL — The powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un denied a South Korean claim that North Korea was apparently behind landmine blasts last week that injured three soldiers, state media reported Wednesday.

data.title: West Bank's violent settlers part of a new generation fuelled by ideology
data.description: JERUSALEM — A mass attack by Israeli settlers on a Palestinian village in the occupied West Bank has placed new focus on the emergence of a generation of radicals in the territory.

data.title: Myanmar arrests 21 over alleged donations to opposition-linked fundraising platform
data.description: NAY PYI TAW — Myanmar's military-backed government has arrested 21 people it said ​had transferred money to an online ‌fundraising platform linked to the opposition National Unity Government (NUG), the state-run Global New Light of Myanmar newspaper reported.

data.title: New Zealand denies breaching climate commitments to EU
data.description: WELLINGTON - New Zealand denied on Wednesday it had broken climate promises made in a free-trade deal with the European Union (EU), after a green group lodged a complaint with Brussels.

data.title: US Supreme Court lifts limits on third-country deportations
data.description: WASHINGTON — The United States Supreme Court on Tuesday lifted restrictions on the deportations of immigrants to countries that are not their own, while agreeing to hear the issue on its merits in December.

data.title: Paw-fect candidate: Australia finds new koala rescue dog
data.description: SYDNEY — After trawling through dozens of applications, the hunt is over: an Australian animal welfare group has found a successor to a hero hound credited with saving more than 100 koalas from fires.

data.title: Pirate island's plunging population shows Greece's demographic decline
data.description: THYMAINA — "Let's go to war!" shouted six-year-old Giorgos at his older cousin, Minas, as the two chased each other with claw-like geranium stalks around the schoolyard on the tiny Greek island of Thymaina.

data.title: Women fight fires and sexism in Indonesian Borneo
data.description: KETAPANG — Housework in the morning followed by several hours of firefighting: women in Indonesian Borneo risk life and limb to battle blazes making their communities sick, all while shouldering a sexist backlash.

data.title: US-led coalition ends mission in Iraq
data.description: ERBIL — After more than a decade, the US-led coalition is ending its mission in Iraq, having helped save the country from jihadists while causing persistent friction.

data.title: UN to hold fourth informal poll of secretary-general candidates
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - The UN Security Council met Tuesday to gauge for a fourth time support for a packed field of contenders to lead the world organization, fresh from making their pitch to world leaders who will decide their fate.

data.title: German far-right aims to lead Saxony-Anhalt govt in December
data.description: BERLIN - The leader of the far-right AfD in the eastern German state of Saxony-Anhalt said Tuesday he hopes to become state premier in December after the party's crushing election victory earlier this month.

data.title: Eiffel Tower chief to step down after ‘hiding’ female staff
data.description: PARIS - The operating company that runs the Eiffel Tower said on Tuesday that its chief would step down at the end of this year in the wake of a controversy over the removal of women staff during a visit by a Hindu religious group.

data.title: Clashes break out as French school blockades intensify
data.description: PARIS - French teenagers on Tuesday set fire to rubbish bins and hurled projectiles at police who responded with batons and tear gas, as pupils kept up blockades and protests at hundreds of high schools, demanding better conditions.
